_comments.format: JSON does not allow inline // comments. This object stores documentation and should be ignored by consumers.

simulation.run_mode: "single" runs one target; "both" runs estimators and resource managers.
simulation.single_run_target: Used only when run_mode is "single". Allowed values: "estimators" or "resource_managers".
simulation.gpu_id: GPU index to use. Set to -1 to force CPU execution.
simulation.force_cpu: If true, always use the CPU even when a GPU is available.
simulation.log_level: Logging level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, or ERROR.
simulation.plot_results: If true, generate plots after each run.

scenario_params.scenario: Channel scenario, for example "umi", "uma", or "rma" if supported.
scenario_params.estimators: Estimators to compare in estimator evaluation mode.
scenario_params.perfect_csi_only: If true, run only the perfect-CSI path when available.
scenario_params.imperfect_csi_only: If true, run only the imperfect-CSI path when available.
scenario_params.batch_size: Number of Monte Carlo samples per batch. Larger values give smoother BER curves per iteration.
scenario_params.max_iter: Legacy iteration cap, used only if the pipeline reads it.
scenario_params.total_batches: Minimum number of batches to run for each Eb/No point before any stopping rule can trigger.
scenario_params.max_mc_batches: Maximum number of Monte Carlo batches per Eb/No point.
scenario_params.target_block_errors: Stop a point once this many block errors have been collected, after the minimum evidence has been met.
scenario_params.target_ber: Stop a point once the one-sided BER confidence bound is below this target, after the minimum evidence has been met. Use null to disable it.
scenario_params.confidence_level: Confidence level for the BER upper-bound estimate.
scenario_params.confidence_max_batches: Legacy alias for the Monte Carlo batch cap.
scenario_params.min_total_bits: Optional minimum total number of transmitted bits required before stopping is allowed.

resource_manager_params.resource_managers: Resource managers to compare in scheduling evaluation mode.
resource_manager_params.cnn_model_path: Legacy CNN checkpoint. Retrain before reuse with the current 5G config.
resource_manager_params.num_active_users: Target number of active users per scheduling interval.
resource_manager_params.active_ut_mask: Optional explicit active-user mask. Use null for the default behavior.
resource_manager_params.per_ut_power: Optional per-user transmit power list. Use null for the default behavior.
resource_manager_params.pilot_reuse_factor: Optional pilot reuse factor. Use null to default to 1.

factory_scenario.room_dimensions: Room dimensions [x, y, z] in meters.
factory_scenario.num_machines: Number of machine obstacles in the factory layout.
factory_scenario.machine_size_range: Minimum and maximum machine box dimensions for synthetic placement.
factory_scenario.materials: Scene material definitions used by the synthetic factory environment.
factory_scenario.materials.metal.name: Material name used in the scene.
factory_scenario.materials.metal.relative_permittivity: Relative permittivity for the metal material.
factory_scenario.materials.metal.conductivity: Conductivity for the metal material in S/m.
factory_scenario.materials.concrete.name: Material name used in the scene.
factory_scenario.materials.concrete.relative_permittivity: Relative permittivity for the concrete material.
factory_scenario.materials.concrete.conductivity: Conductivity for the concrete material in S/m.

system_params.num_ofdm_symbols: Number of OFDM symbols per slot.
system_params.pilot_ofdm_symbol_indices: OFDM symbol indices used for pilots.
system_params.num_ut_ant: Number of antennas per user terminal.
system_params.num_bits_per_symbol: Modulation order in bits per symbol.

ray_tracing_params.samples_per_src: Number of rays sampled per source. Lower this to reduce memory use.
ray_tracing_params.max_paths: Maximum propagated paths retained per link.

transceiver_params.tx_height_offset: Transmitter height offset from the reference plane in meters.
transceiver_params.wall_thickness: Wall thickness used for geometry and material interactions in meters.
transceiver_params.room_padding: Extra margin around the room layout in meters.
transceiver_params.rx_boundary_padding: Minimum receiver distance from room boundaries in meters.
